tripc.title: My trips
tripc.intro: Plan your days, see the real forecast for each activity, and let the weather checker suggest changes. Nothing is changed until you approve it.
tripc.empty: You have no trips yet. Create one above.
tripc.new.title: New trip
tripc.field.name: Trip name
tripc.err.name: Please type a name for the trip.
tripc.err.dates: Please choose a first day and a last day that is the same day or later.
tripc.err.activity: This place has no activity to choose.
tripc.err.quick: That place or those dates were not valid. Please choose again.
tripc.delete_body: "{name}" and its packing list will be deleted from this device. This cannot be undone.
tripc.notfound: This trip was not found on this device.
tripc.nodestinations: The list of places is not available, so activities cannot be added.
tripc.add.title: Add an activity
tripc.chip.noforecast: No forecast yet for this day
tripc.status.noitems: Add an activity to see its weather.
tripc.status.failed: The forecast could not be loaded and there is no saved copy. No changes are proposed.
tripc.review.title: Weather check
tripc.review.none: No problems found in the days that have a forecast. Nothing needs to change.
tripc.review.beyond: {n} planned activities are beyond the forecast. They are not checked: there is no forecast for them yet.
tripc.review.locked_warn: This is a confirmed booking ({day}, {slot}), so it will not be changed. Check the weather yourself and decide.
tripc.confirm.title: Approve these changes?
tripc.confirm.intro: These {n} change(s) will be saved to your itinerary:
tripc.confirm.note: Confirmed bookings and every item you did not choose stay as they are.
tripc.pack.title: Packing assistant
tripc.pack.intro: A checklist made from the weather forecast and your activities, with the reason for each item.
tripc.pack.notrips: You have no saved trips. Use the quick list below or create a trip first.
tripc.pack.quick: Quick list for a place and dates
tripc.pack.needsitems: "{name}" has no activities or dates yet. Add some first, then the packing list can be made.
tripc.pack.multi: This trip visits several places. The weather used here is for {name}, where most activities are.
tripc.pack.updated: List updated from the latest forecast. Your ticks and items were kept.
tripc.pack.updated_old: The latest forecast could not be loaded. The list uses the last saved copy.
tripc.pack.last_update: List last rebuilt from the weather: {time}
tripc.pack.noforecast_error: The forecast could not be loaded. Only items that do not depend on the weather are suggested, plus an umbrella as a precaution.
tripc.pack.noforecast_days: These dates are beyond the forecast (about {days} days). Only items that do not depend on the weather are suggested, plus an umbrella as a precaution. Update the list later.
tripc.pack.partial: Only {n} of {total} days have a forecast. The list uses those days.
tripc.pack.saved_note: Ticks and your own items are saved on this device ({where}).
tripc.pack.where_quick: for this place and these dates
